description:
An envelope whose `signed` is not three dot-separated base64url segments. Step 1 parses the envelope before any allocation on attacker-controlled data, so this is refused before a suite is read or a key resolved — nothing below step 1 runs.

It does **not** cover a transport delivering bytes that are not JSON at all: a vector file is JSON and a runner is handed a parsed object, so that case cannot travel through this corpus. It belongs to the binding that owns framing ([P-013](../docs/prds/P-013-https-binding.md)).
